settings.features_text:
3D laser-engraved character inside a 50mm glass crystal ball
LED lamp base included, with a multi-color automatic gradient glow
36 characters to collect, all options include the base
Button battery included, simple switch operation
Ships protected in a foam box so ball and base arrive intact
settings.shipping_text: Free tracked shipping on every order, shipped from our US-based team. Orders are processed within 1 to 2 business days. Every purchase is covered by our 30-day money-back guarantee. See our Shipping Policy and Return and Refund Policy for full details.
